column1: # convention. The IDF default single-MB factory partition stops
# fitting the firmware once PSRAM is enabled (PSRAM heap
# management code adds ~60 KB to the binary; `app_check_size`
# prints "1% free" warnings). 1.5 MB leaves comfortable headroom
# future WebSocket control plane without needing a follow-up
# Layout on a 4 MB SPI flash:
# No OTA partition: the device ships without an OTA update
# path today. Add an `ota_0` / `ota_1` pair here when OTA is
# introduced; `factory` will need to shrink back to ~1 MB to
# fit two app images plus their state.
